patch_notes:
🔧 VERSION 1.1 STABILIZATION UPDATE
This release focuses on critical bug fixes, crash resolutions, and system hardening to deliver a stable, production-ready experience.

🐛 CRITICAL BUG FIXES:
• Grayscale Filter Recovery: Fixed the broken grayscale filter (AttributeError) that prevented image filters from applying correctly via the context menu.
• Periodic Cleanup Crash: Resolved critical memory management crashes in the TTS audio pipeline and temporary file cleanup systems that caused random application termination.
• Drawing Engine Stability: Fixed PyQt6 macro description errors in the undo system and corrected signal-slot connections preventing brush/canvas crashes.
• Skill Tree Synchronization: Corrected the Analytical Skill Tree update logic - skill progress bars (Gesture, Proportion, Anatomy, Planes, Detail) now properly update based on AI analysis feedback.

🎨 UI/UX IMPROVEMENTS:
• Challenge Layout Fix: Resolved text cut-off issues in the 30-Day Challenge calendar interface for better task readability.
• HUD Controls: Added dedicated checkboxes and UI visibility toggles for Pomodoro and Timelapse floating HUDs.
• Checkbox-Overpaint Link: Restored the broken connection between the 'Drawing Protocol' checkbox and the overpaint HUD system.

🤖 AI & MODELS:
• Expanded OpenAI Support: Added support for latest OpenAI model lineup including GPT-5 series, GPT-4.1 variants, and o4-mini reasoning models.

🌍 LOCALIZATION & TRANSLATIONS:
• Complete Translation Keys: Added all missing translation keys for auto-generated UI elements, error messages, and system notifications.
• Language Completion: Filled lacking translation files for Polish, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and remaining supported languages.

⚙️ SYSTEM & MAINTENANCE:
• Updated Web Sources: Refreshed AI Radar scraping lists - removed dead domains (CGSociety, legacy Polycount) and added 2026-verified sources (Pixiv, Cara.app, Lemanoosh, GrabCAD, etc.).
• Repository Cleanup: Implemented proper .gitignore rules for large ML models (MediaPipe, Rembg, ONNX) to prevent repository bloat.
